summary.text: Dan Feyen is a Republican member of the Wisconsin Senate representing District 20, based in Fond du Lac, and has been elected to the Senate since 2016.
He chairs the Committee on Government Operations, Labor and Economic Development and has held the Assistant Majority Leader position.

paragraphs.text: Feyen was born in New Holstein, Wisconsin, and is married with two children.
He graduated from New Holstein High School in 1986 and earned a diploma in printing from Fox Valley Technical College in 1988.
His occupation is listed as print and bindery coordinator.
The Legislature's page lists him as a former chair of both the Fond du Lac County Republican Party and the 6th District Republican Party.
He is a member of the Knights of Columbus, the Elks Club and the Fond du Lac Noon Rotary Club, and a major in the Wisconsin Wing of the Civil Air Patrol Legislative Squadron.

In the Senate he has held the Assistant Majority Leader position in 2019, 2021 and 2023, and he is vice-chair of the Committee on Utilities, Technology and Tourism and co-chair of the Joint Survey Committee on Retirement Systems.
